title: machaeranthera canescens var. incana
intro: Machaeranthera canescens var. incana, commonly known as Hoary Greenthread or Gray Headed Greenthread, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits in reducing pain and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Hoary Greenthread include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and expectorant, making it useful in treating conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Hoary Greenthread include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
